_comment: Corsican language resources that may be downloaded and reused. tools/fetch_resources.py downloads them into ~/.local/share/corsu/resources (or $CORSU_RESOURCES) and records the date and checksum in manifest.json there. Lookup-only dictionaries are listed in resources/README.md, not here.

resources.name: Mozilla Pontoon terminology, Corsican
resources.license: Mozilla project content (MPL-2.0); check each project
resources.coverage: about 211 software terms with definitions, approved by the Corsican Mozilla team
resources.variants: standard written Corsican used in software

resources.name: Mozilla Pontoon translation memory, Corsican, all projects
resources.license: Mozilla project content (MPL-2.0); check each project
resources.coverage: English-Corsican sentence pairs from Firefox for Android and iOS, Focus, Mozilla VPN, Common Voice, SUMO
resources.variants: standard written Corsican used in software

resources.name: English Wiktionary, Corsican entries (wiktextract JSONL)
resources.coverage: about 900 Corsican words with English glosses, inflections and some regional forms
resources.variants: labels such as Cismontane, Ultramontane, Sartenese when the entry has them

resources.name: Wikizziunariu (Corsican Wiktionary) dump
resources.coverage: about 9,600 pages, many of them non-Corsican words

resources.name: Vikipedia (Corsican Wikipedia) dump
resources.coverage: about 9,500 articles, a corpus to check whether a form is in use

resources.name: Apertium Corsican monolingual dictionary
resources.coverage: about 6,300 lemmas with inflection paradigms; last updated 2021

resources.name: Unicode CLDR locale data, Corsican
resources.coverage: language, territory, month and day names

resources.name: OPUS translatewiki co-en (MediaWiki interface strings)
resources.license: translatewiki.net content (CC BY-SA / GPL per project)

resources.name: Patriccollu, Lingua_Corsa-Infurmatica (notes, translation memories, translated files)
resources.license: no license file: kept locally for consultation only, never redistributed
resources.coverage: per-program notes and memories (Audacity, Poedit) by the main Corsican software translator
resources.variants: standard written Corsican used in software
